commits.body:
All sixteen disclosed public callers were compiled to their locked class digest. Each of 54 input histories ran on each original deployment through the ordinary application loader and a separate resource-recording loader before solving. The receipts bind startup, class origins, resource lookups, ordered providers, expected results, controls and the point where the frozen automatic scaffolding stopped. Batik opened its parser properties and service registrations. The dom4j factory loaded in its original namespace. All 30 affected test groups passed.

Five jobs remeasure the unchanged automatic selector with the successor checker and the original signed packets. Both calibration JARs were reconstructed byte for byte, all 64 frozen candidate records passed the comparator cross-check, and job schemas validated. Jobs 20261124-230538-remeasure-the-frozen-automatic-callers-0, 20261124-230549-05-08-repeat-of-the-frozen-automatic-cal, 20261124-230549-09-12-repeat-of-the-frozen-automatic-cal, 20261124-230549-13-16-repeat-of-the-frozen-automatic-cal and 20261124-230549-calibration-repeat-of-the-frozen-automat.
